claim: MN 123 contains a canonical miraculous birth narrative for the bodhisatta, including the newborn standing and taking seven steps; a modern relief can therefore represent a canonical textual tradition without becoming evidence that those miraculous details occurred historically.
bounded_by: Confidence A applies to the presence of the motif in the canonical text, not to historical verification of the miracle or to the relief's modern provenance.
notes: Supports the evidence label of ILL-KANDY-03 while preserving tradition-versus-history semantics.
